name: Smart Search's header button on a desktop at 1366x900: as viewer, one 'Advanced search' button right before jellyfin-web's search button, the same size and colour, which opens the page by mouse and by keyboard (Shift+Tab from the search button, then Enter); still one, shown, after client navigation (home, a library, the page, the dashboard and back); hidden with the search button after signing out (the login page); none shown in the experimental layout (jellyfin-web keeps the legacy header there, hidden). Then as admin: ShowHeaderButton off and the page off each take the button away on the next load, and both are put back; and with jellyfin-web's search button made unfindable, no button, one console warning and one health report the server lists, never a throw. Screenshots smartsearch-header-*.png.

steps.name: simulate a jellyfin-web without the anchor: from the next load, its search button loses the class headerSearchButton as soon as it is built (jellyfin-web already holds the node)
steps.initScript: new MutationObserver(() => { document.querySelectorAll('.headerSearchButton').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('headerSearchButton')); }).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });

the health report goes out (the kit waits about 2 s after a miss)

the server lists the report (Diagnostics' ClientHealth)
steps.waitFor: ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('SmartSearch/Admin/Diagnostics')).then(d => { const w = d.WebAnchors || {}; const text = JSON.stringify(d); return (w.Reports || {}).Accepted >= 1 && text.indexOf('headerSearch') >= 0 ? { accepted: w.Reports.Accepted } : false; })
